title: record page read mode truncates text instead of wrapping: a case subject reads "Data export timing out for large...", an article summary "A five-minute tour of accounts,...", and the highlights strip shows SLA due as "2026/10/2…"
body:
Filing gate **① a user-visible defect with a named landing site**. Batch-of: 2026-10-25 browser pass on @objectstack/* 18.1.0 (23 cards: hotcrm 10, objectui 10, objectstack 3). Filed by the maintainer's account (`os-steve`) from the HotCRM pass driven in session `session_01AwpXhq2nFKU6J7GmbCEmZu`; ⛔ not a claim. Grade and routing are objectui triage's.

## What is seen (HotCRM on `@objectstack/console` 18.1.0, 1440×900)

| place | field | shown | full value |
|---|---|---|---|
| case record, 工单信息 section, read mode | `subject` (text) | `Data export timing out for large...` | `Data export timing out for large datasets` |
| knowledge article, 文章信息 section | `summary` (textarea) | `A five-minute tour of accounts,...` | the whole two-line summary |
| case record, highlights strip | `sla_due_date` (datetime) | `2026/10/2…` | `2026/10/26 上午10:00` |
| case record, page title | `display_title` | `CASE-00002 · Data export timing out for large …` | (title truncation is fine; the body field is not) |

The section field sits in a two-column grid with room to its right; the value is clipped to one line with an ellipsis instead of wrapping. On the highlight strip the date loses its day. [52-case-tall.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/52-case-tall.png), [57-article-tall.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/57-article-tall.png).

`reach:` the public UI, measured once as the dev admin.

## Expected

- `record:details` read mode wraps `text` and `textarea` values (the textarea case is objectstack-ai/objectui#11577's family, closed; this is its 18.1.0 reading on a plain `text` field too).
- The highlights strip shortens a datetime by format (drop the time, then the year) before it ellipsizes, or lets the cell grow; a date that loses its day is worse than a wider cell.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` objectui "record detail text field truncated with ellipsis instead of wrapping" → 6 hits: objectstack-ai/objectui#11577 (closed, textarea one line in read mode), objectstack-ai/objectui#11684 (closed, drawer highlight truncation), objectstack-ai/objectui#12506, objectstack-ai/objectui#13149, objectstack-ai/objectui#12618, objectstack-ai/objectui#13292 — none open, none covers the plain-text section field or the datetime highlight. Report: [REPORT.md](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/REPORT.md) §3.6.
